thread:
alex.ng: Incoming external assessment: vendor scheduled for next Tue 11:00 PST. Scope = staging + infra auth paths. Need: RBAC snapshot, KMS access pattern, evidence packaging. Who can own intake?
priya: I can take intake. Quick questions: do we give assessor ephemeral roles or reading-room creds?
alex.ng: Prefer ephemeral roles with timeboxed session. We discussed KMS proxy earlier — will that be ready?
mike-infra: KMS proxy is in staging but needs a small config change (allow-list for assessor IPs). I can push an allowlist and a temp role mapping tomorrow morning.
sara-ops: Re test slots: suggest 2-hour window, 11-13 PST. We'll capture logs to S3 prefix: s3://redwood-pt/3921001234/. Please upload evidence there.
priya: Can you add retention policy 90d and pre-signed URLs for the assessor? Also need CloudTrail slices for the window.
mike-infra: Will add bucket policy and pre-signed URL script. Example script:
```
aws s3 presign s3://redwood-pt/3921001234/session-logs.tar.gz --expires-in 86400
```
sec-bot: Reminder: create JIRA ticket RW-SEC-2027 and tag with 'assessor-intake'.
alex.ng: Created RW-SEC-2027, linked to runbook: https://internal/redwood/runbooks/assessor-intake
priya: Action items: 1) RBAC snapshot export (alex), 2) KMS proxy allowlist (mike), 3) S3 retention + presign (mike), 4) evidence checklist + upload (sara), 5) pre-retest validation (oncall-sre).
oncall-sre: I will run pre-retest readiness checklist 24h before. Need list of critical endpoints to smoke test.
sara-ops: Critical endpoints: /api/generate, /api/embeddings, internal-admin console. I'll paste a short smoke script in RW-SEC-2027.
priya: Also: confirm that KMS logs are forwarded to SIEM and that KMS decrypt events are included in evidence. If not, we need a short-term export.
mike-infra: KMS decrypt logs go to CloudWatch under /aws/kms. I'll add a subscription filter to the evidence export. ETA EOD tomorrow.
alex.ng: Thanks. Priya, can you prepare a remediation tracking sheet for the findings with columns: vuln id, severity, owner, remediation ETA, evidence link?
priya: On it. Will create a Google Sheet and link in the ticket.
sec-bot: Note: retained logs must be redacted for PII before handing to assessor. See policy: https://internal/redwood/policies/evidence-redaction
sara-ops: Good point, will run redaction job on session logs before presign.
priya: Final ask: please confirm which roles will be ephemeral and the exact IAM policy snippets so we can include them in the assessor brief.
mike-infra: I'll post the IAM snippet in RW-SEC-2027 when I push the allowlist.
alex.ng: Meeting to finalize: Mon 09:30 PST quick sync. If anything blocks earlier ping me. :thumbsup:
